    10  /-! # Local properties of processes
    11  
    12  This file defines local and stable properties of stochastic processes with respect to a filtration.
    13  This is notably useful for local martingales.
    14  
    15  ## Main definitions
    16  
    17  * `IsPreLocalizingSequence`: A pre-localizing sequence is a sequence of stopping
    18    times which tends almost surely to infinity.
    19  * `IsLocalizingSequence`: A localizing sequence is a pre-localizing sequence
    20    which is almost surely non-decreasing.
    21  * `Locally`: A stochastic process `X` is said to satisfy a property `p` locally
    22    with respect to a filtration `𝓕` if there exists a localizing sequence `(τ n)` such that for all
    23    `n`, the stopped process `X^{τ n} I_{τ n > ⊥}` satisfies `p`.
    24  * `IsStable`: A property of stochastic processes is said to be stable if it is
    25    preserved under taking the stopped process `X^{τ} I_{τ > ⊥}` by a stopping time `τ`.
    26  
    27  ## Main results
    28  
    29  * `IsStable.isStable_locally`: If a property `p` is stable, then the property
    30    "satisfies `p` locally" is also stable.
    31  * `IsPreLocalizingSequence.isLocalizingSequence_biInf`: Given a
    32    pre-localizing sequence `(τ n)`, the sequence `⊓ j ≥ n, τ j` is a localizing sequence.
    33  * `IsStable.locally_of_isPreLocalizingSequence`: If a property `p` is stable, then
    34    to prove that `X` satisfies `p` locally, one can replace the localizing sequence in the definition
    35    of "locally" by a pre-localizing sequence.
    36  * `IsStable.locally_locally`: For stable properties, locally is idempotent.
    37  * `IsStable.locally_induction`: If `q` is a stable property, and `p` implies
    38    locally `q`, then locally `p` implies locally `q`.
    39  
    40  ### Tags
    41  
    42  localizing sequence, local property, stable property
    43  -/
